versions.content: DID ranges cannot be mapped on DDDIDs, be- cause service 0x2C DDDID does not support the range feature. Practi- cally DcmDspDidRangeIdentifierLowerLimit and DcmDspDidRangeIdenti- fierUpperLimit should not include DIDs of the range 0xF200 till 0xF3FF. Any defined range shall only reference DcmDspDidInfo via DcmDspDidRangeInfoRef , having set DcmDspDidDynamicallyDefined == False.
